title: Jet Ski San Diego
specs: No boating license or special experience required
blurb: Guests rent jet skis for a set duration to ride in designated areas of San Diego Bay. No boating license or special experience is required. The rental includes the jet ski and necessary equipment.
extraNote: Cancellation policy explained in FAQ · 20% fee plus $11 fuel surcharge applies
requirements: No boating license or special experience required
bring: Wear appropriate clothing for water activity

quotes.text: Jet ski San Diego is great!! The owner is well organized, knowledgeable, and very welcoming. The process for rental is super convenient, and the rental is reasonably priced. When we arrived, check in was quick, the safety video made the rider feel comfortable/confident, and any item you could think of needing (life vest, hair ties, sun glasses lanyard, and phone dry bag, etc.) was offered/provided. The employees communicated and provided their number on the jet ski, and informed riders that they would come out and help if needed. Best part, we had a blast!! 10/10!

John and Leah were amazing! They made the entire jet ski experience easy, fun, and unforgettable. They were friendly, professional, and made sure we felt comfortable before heading out. The jet skis were in great condition, and everything was organized from start to finish. We had an incredible time and can’t recommend them enough. Thank you both for an amazing experience—we’ll definitely be back!

HAD A BLAST! Highly recommend this company for your jet ski rentals, transparency in fees from the start and competitive pricing with other rental companies. Free parking is a huge bonus as well as the included jackets, wet suits, phone cases and glasses lanyards. Would definitely choose this for my next jet ski rental!!

Had an amazing time!! I was pretty nervous at first but it was so much fun and John explained everything in detail which left me confident on the water. Can’t wait to come again!! They offer sunglass straps and iPhone clear packs. You don’t wear shoes on the jet ski so don’t worry about that! APPLY SUNSCREEN lol.

What an awesome time! I would recommend this place to everyone. Very affordable, reasonable, and the staff was just amazing and helped us so much! We had a blast and will definitely be back! John and Sam were so nice and made sure we understood all the rules and felt comfortable before we took off.

Amazing fun! This was my first time riding a jet ski and it was so much fun! The jet skis were well maintained and easily to handle! Plenty of open space to cruise or go fast! Just remember to wear sunscreen!
